preservedReasons.NPC.cs.4066: The complete source is a dynamic name placeholder followed by an exclamation mark. There is no lexical English text to translate.

contextNotes.Game1.cs.2640: Festival name {0} is a quoted nominative label after generic festival. Mandatory trailing space joins the previously accepted location fragment.
contextNotes.Game1.cs.3094: Player's arbitrary favorite-thing text is appended raw, followed by3101. A colon introduces its uninflected content; do not add a final period before the shared suffix.
contextNotes.Game1.cs.3095: Favorite-thing text is introduced after нешто: to avoid inflecting arbitrary player-entered wording.
contextNotes.Game1.cs.3099: Preserve creator's literal brand ConcernedApe; Serbian genitive suffix follows a hyphen, not mixed-script text inside one word.
contextNotes.Game1.cs.3100: Retain special = marker immediately before the canonical Stardrop name and final space; use neutral found-item sentence.
contextNotes.Game1.cs.3101: Preserve initial period, intervening space and both ^^ delimiters; fragment closes the favorite-thing insertion.
contextNotes.Game1.cs.3159: Eat/drink confirmations use nominative item DisplayName after a colon, preserving the action and {0}.
contextNotes.Game1.cs.3666: F4 is the exact source keyboard shortcut; retain isolated Latin F with its numeric key designation.
contextNotes.Game1.cs.3686: Preserve exact original contact URL and @ConcernedApe handle as technical identifiers; translate only the crash-report request.
contextNotes.NPC.cs.3955: Nominative coordinated subject ти и {0} avoids declension of arbitrary NPC name; wilted-bouquet breakup uses the same subject frame.
contextNotes.NPC.cs.3962: Original two slash-separated speaker-gender branches are retained; first self-reference знао, second знала. Do not conflate this slash switch with player-gender ^.
contextNotes.NPC.cs.3972: Shared marriage response uses ступим у брак, valid for either speaker gender and either player gender.
contextNotes.NPC.cs.3985: Jealous spouse and gift recipient genders are arbitrary. Indefinite неко добио takes grammatical masculine without assigning the named recipient's gender; recipient is named separately in nominative.
contextNotes.NPC.cs.3987: Both recipient and count remain uninflected labels. The notification retains the weekly gift-limit prohibition.
contextNotes.NPC.cs.4001: Any spouse may speak; neutral намера ми је била avoids masculine/feminine self-reference.
